categories.name: Resolve via timely payment
categories.description: Cases resolved through prompt payment of the fine, advancing the softgoal 'Maximize timely fine revenue' and helping 'Minimize administrative & enforcement cost', judged against indicator 'Average time to case closure'.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id=12, supported by frequent variants such as V0002 and V0007 where payment concludes the case early.

categories.name: Resolve via delinquent payment
categories.description: Cases resolved through payment made after penalties have been added and notifications sent, helping 'Maximize timely fine revenue', judged against indicator 'Average time to case closure'.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id=13, supported by variants like V0004, V0005, and V0006 where payments occur subsequent to notification and penalty steps.

categories.name: Resolve via administrative appeal to the Prefecture
categories.description: Cases involving an administrative appeal process directed to the Prefecture, preserving offender's due-process rights while potentially increasing costs and delaying revenue, judged against 'Time to appeal filing, Prefecture'.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id=14, evidenced by variants containing appeal insertion and transmission steps such as V0008, V0057, and V0135.

categories.name: Resolve via judicial appeal to the Judge
categories.description: Cases involving judicial appeal to a judge, strongly making 'Preserve offender's due-process rights' while hurting cost minimization, judged against 'Time to appeal filing, Judge'.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id=19, supported by variants showing 'Appeal to Judge' actions such as V0103, V0140, and V0176.

categories.name: Resolve via coercive credit collection
categories.description: Cases escalated and resolved through coercive credit collection measures, helping revenue maximization but hurting cost minimization, judged against 'Average time to case closure'.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id=20, evidenced by variants culminating in 'Send for Credit Collection' like V0001, V0009, and V0134.

categories.name: Resolve via fine annulment
categories.description: Cases resulting in the annulment of the fine.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to the declared alternative id=187 as declared in the goal model decomposition.
